sample_selection: Fixed SHA256 ordering;8perstratum;24distinct;prior30excluded. Paired strata require lexical relation cue; human stratum requires human word. Graph tags alone were found insufficient before any images were viewed;v1 preserved locally, v2 locked before image viewing. Not GT.
policy: Original nonempty phrase + valid original region + established COCO/cache identity/aspect. No pair match, class/edge-count/phrase-length/lexical/spatial blacklist gate.
heldout_policy: All5000COCOval+5000COCOtest plus568known-exposed IDs excluded; train/restval only.
constraints: Restricted to existing cache cohort for image identity/selected-pair strata. These are not full-VG counts or validated supervision labels.
checksum_scope: Exact UTF-8/LF manifest bytes; newline normalization does not change sample rows or review labels. Git eol=lf is pinned for this hashed manifest.
